entities.name: Ulrik Christian Gyldenløve, Count of Samsø
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ulrik Christian Gyldenløve, Count of Samsø was a Danish Admiral in the Royal Danish-Norwegian Navy and Governor of Iceland. He was an acknowledged illegitimate son of King Christian V of Denmark and his officially acknowledged royal mistress Sophie Amalie Moth.
